description.intro: With this Nike short from FC Barcelona, you will train with the comfort and freedom of movement you need. Its breathable design and elastic fabric adapt to your rhythm, while the club’s official look accompanies you in each session. Ideal to take your passion to the next level.
key_benefits: Optimized breathability: The Dri-FIT fabric moves the sweat away to keep you dry and concentrated.
Movement without limits: The fit and elastic fabric improve mobility.
Inspiration Barça: Official design of Barcelona season 2025/26.
Comodidad ligera: Material suave y ligero para uso prolongado.
